items.title: 24 Security Vulnerabilities Patched in curl Used Across 30 Billion Installations
items.description: The curl project released curl 8.23.0 on October 14, 2026, announcing 24 security fixes affecting the widely used data transfer tool and its underlying library, libcurl. The vulnerabilities include credential leaks, authentication errors, command injection, and flaws that can disrupt applications. The release also removes SMB and SMBS protocol support, making compatibility checks important…

items.description: A flaw in how curl handles HTTP/2 uploads lets a malicious server receiving an upload corrupt the client's memory, and the researcher who reported it turned that into code execution on the uploading machine. The curl project fixed it on October 14 in curl 8.23.0. Taking over a client needs exact knowledge of its build and memory layout, and curl expects a real attack to end in a crash
